thread:
Alex Nguyen: Quick sync — starting Melbourne region (au-mel) preflight today. Need clear owners for routing, KMS, DB replicas, and smoke tests. Target canary next Wed (low-traffic window). Any immediate blockers?

Trina Patel: I can take routing/peering + CSR with cloud. I have a PR open for the route policy config: https://git.company/repo/pulls/842. Needs a review for the priority weights.

Sam Ortiz: I'll own infra provisioning (VMs, GPU pools, autoscale). Question: do we want dedicated pools for au-mel or share burst capacity from au-syd for now?

Maria Lopez: On DB replicas. I can spin up a read replica in au-mel but need the migration window and write-fence plan. Also need the replica user creds (ro_role).

Cheng Wu: Oncall / cutover support. Recommend canary at 02:00-04:00 AEST. Also flagging that we need KMS key and regional HSM policy before we pass traffic for residency customers.

Alex Nguyen: Good. Plan: Trina -> routing, Sam -> infra, Maria -> DB, Cheng -> cutover/oncall. @security-team please create KMS alias `alias/redwood/au-mel` and enable cross-region restrictions. We need key ARN for vaults before EOD tomorrow.

security-team: Ack, creating request ticket. ETA ~6 hours. Will post key ARN here when ready.

Trina Patel: Routing snippet I put in the PR (excerpt):
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: /api/*
    upstreams:
      - name: au-mel-primary
        weight: 100
      - name: au-syd-fallback
        weight: 10
```
We should confirm weight numbers with infra after Sam decides pool strategy.

Sam Ortiz: Let's share burst for now (less cost). I'll allocate 2 reserved nodes and allow burst to au-syd for spike traffic. Will update infra playbook.

Maria Lopez: For DB, prefer maintenance window 03:00-04:00 AEST to minimize impact. I'll prepare migration script and a preflight check list. Need `replica_user` secret in Secrets Manager with read-only. @alex can you confirm?

Alex Nguyen: Confirmed. Create secret path `secrets/au-mel/replica_user`. Keep TTL per usual. Maria, add preflight checklist items for failback and replication lag threshold (set to 2s).

Cheng Wu: Canary test plan: 500 requests over 10 minutes, 95th latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%. We'll run canary traffic through the lineage router to validate header preservation.

Alex Nguyen: Nice. Also: Q for docs/devex — need a quick runbook section for region onboarding (short checklist) so support knows the knobs. @Trina @Sam can you add 3 bullets to the runbook? Link: https://confluence.company/eng/onboarding-regions

Trina Patel: I'll add routing + peering items.

Sam Ortiz: I'll add infra provisioning and autoscale hints (include expected GPU metrics).

deploy-bot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-au-mel-2026-03-31-09, scheduled 2026-04-02T02:15:00+10:00.

infra-bot: Staging smoke tests passed for au-mel: all checks green (conn, kv, auth). Report: https://ci.company/builds/112233

Maria Lopez: Smoke looks good. Will run db-consistency check tonight and post results.

Alex Nguyen: OK — blockers: none outstanding besides KMS ARN and replica secret. @security-team and @infra-bot pls ping when done. We'll do an async sync via this thread for status; call if anything urgent. Thanks all :thumbsup:

security-team: KMS key provisioned. Key ARN: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-4:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Added policy to restrict to au-mel VPCs.

infra-bot: Secret `secrets/au-mel/replica_user` created by automation. Access granted to DB-admin role.

Sam Ortiz: Provisioning completed for reserved nodes. Autoscale configured. Pushing PR for infra playbook updates: https://git.company/repo/pulls/847

Trina Patel: Route PR merged after small tweak to weights. Peering scheduled for tomorrow morning.

Cheng Wu: Oncall schedule updated for canary window. I’ll be on rotation with Maria.

Alex Nguyen: Perfect. I'll close the loop after the first canary run and post a short summary. If anyone sees anything odd in staging tonight, call me. Thanks everyone!
